title: Surface shadcn widget vocabulary
description: Locally developed widget contracts for @rusl-labs/surface-shadcn. Existing input and email widgets retain the surface.default-kit vocabulary.

textarea.title: Multiline text
textarea.description: Edits a string with the consuming application's local shadcn Textarea. Display mode renders the text without changing its wire value.

rows.description: Visible text rows; does not constrain the string length.
